newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mixed,mainly lower in weak demand.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mixed,mainly lower in weak demand.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Thursday.

Gasoline barges sank and running refinery material traded as low as $186.50 fob ARA. Cargoes sank more, under the weight of poor prompt demand. Naphtha was around three dollars a tonne weaker amid poor demand.
Gas oil was firmer as benchmark IPE futures reversed some of Wednesday's $5.0 losses. Heating oil barges traded at July IPE - 50 cents fob ARA.

High sulphur fuel oil barges sank to trade as low as $81.50 fob ARA or some $2.50 below Wednesday's close and earlier traders were around the $82 mark. Traders pinned the weakness on weak demand and a major stopping its attempts to drive the market higher.
High sulphur cargoes seemed weaker with a cargo offered out of Scandinavia at a few dollars below its levels last week and a Russian cracked was also offered at a slightly lower two means minus $1.
One percent was offered steady at $94.50 fob with at least three potential buyers seen for a cargo.
